ESPN, which is the only partner on SEC athletics, employing a writer who posts articles ripping coaches and stirring up racial angst through politics, is absolutely insane to me.

It feels like it happened overnight, but after decades in the fashion wilderness, jean shorts are back. Every teenage boy in Nashville is wearing them, including my sons. Huge moment for Florida Gator fans everywhere. It’s your time.

Kamala Harris will be the 2028 Democrat presidential nominee. She is going to run the most identity politics laden campaign in history and argue it’s racist and sexist if she isn’t the nominee. Save the Tweet. I’m right.

Video
The Braves presently have a 9.5 game lead in the NL East. The other five MLB division leaders combined have a 7.5 game lead.

If you don’t have money in the stock market this is 100% a personal choice you have made. And it’s a very bad one. You can legit start investing with $5 or $10 a week. If you have free time to Tweet and zero money invested, it would be better spent working and investing.
